items.title: 5 Stocks I am Retiring On
items.summary: A retirement portfolio needs businesses that can keep rewarding shareholders long after the current market narrative fades. Dividends show how important those quieter sources of return can be: according to S&P Dow Jones Indices research cited in our coverage of Dividend Aristocrat stocks, dividends have accounted for roughly 31% of the S&P 500’s total return […]

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's image tarnished by board investigation and affair, analysts say
items.summary: Nvidia's board of directors said Sunday it will launch an investigation into its CEO Jensen Huang, after he revealed he had an affair with a former Chinese executive.
